morning4_start.name: Me
morning4_start.text: *Day four. Weekend. -- Today isn't school. It's a date.*

morning4_start_2.name: Me
morning4_start_2.text: *Just pulling that word out of my head makes my heart race. I'm pathetic. I check my phone. A morning message.*

morning4_yuna_msg_1.name: 유나(Yuna)
morning4_yuna_msg_1.text: "10 o'clock. Cafe in front of the station. If you're late, I'm leaving."

morning4_dain_msg_1.name: 다인(Dain)
morning4_dain_msg_1.text: "Today's the day!!!! In front of the gym at 11!! I'm kinda nervous lol, wait should I even be sending this"

morning4_end.name: Me
morning4_end.text: *My heart is pounding. Let's get ready.*
